_comment_iceberg: OPTIONAL. Delete this whole 'iceberg' section, or set enabled to false, to keep the original console-only behaviour. Everything under 'catalog' is passed straight through to PyIceberg. Any value written as 'env:NAME' is read from that environment variable at startup, so real access keys never need to be written to a file. When enabled, Kafka offsets are committed only after the matching records are durable in Iceberg (at-least-once; a replay can duplicate rows). See README.md.
